notes.meaning: Solomon looks at all the cruel treatment happening in the world. Powerful people harm those under them, and no one dares to comfort the victims because they fear the rulers. It is heartbreaking to see great power used to hurt others instead of protecting them.

Looking only at earthly misery, the writer says those who have already died are better off than those still suffering through life. Even more fortunate is someone who was never born at all and never had to see such wickedness. This dark thought shows what life feels like when we look only at this world without keeping God's future judgment and eternal hope in view.

The Preacher sees that much of the hard work and success in this world is driven by jealousy of others. When someone succeeds through honest effort, neighbors often envy and resent them instead of celebrating them. Labor that only aims to outdo someone else brings no lasting peace.

The lazy person goes to the opposite extreme by folding his hands and refusing to work. By doing nothing, he brings himself to total ruin and starves his own body. True wisdom avoids both greedy competition and foolish laziness.

Having a single handful of food with quiet peace of mind is far better than having both hands stuffed full through painful striving. A modest, quiet life with enough to get by brings far more joy than greedy ambition that chases after the wind.

Here is a lonely man who has no partner, child, or brother, yet he works endlessly to pile up riches. He is never satisfied with what he sees, and he never stops to ask who will get his wealth or why he denies himself simple joys. Living entirely for money while cutting off all family and friends is a bitter and empty trap.

Companionship is far better than a lonely life of greed. When two people work together, their combined efforts bring greater success and mutual benefit. Working alongside others produces lasting fruit that a person working all alone cannot enjoy.

If two people travel or work together and one trips and falls, the other is right there to help him up. But a person who walks completely alone is in great danger if trouble comes, because nobody is there to lift him. Good friends protect and restore one another in times of danger, weakness, or sin.

On cold nights, two people lying close together can share their body warmth, but someone sleeping alone stays cold. Companionship provides real comfort and shelter against harsh conditions. In the same way, close Christian friendship warms the heart and encourages love.

An attacker can easily overpower a solitary traveler, but two people standing together can fight back and defend themselves. A rope made of three twisted strands is even harder to snap. God designed people to find strength and security in community rather than facing life's battles alone.

other.label: Popular modern teaching
other.view: Many Christians apply the three strands to marriage, seeing the husband, wife, and God bound together in a covenant that cannot easily be broken.

notes.meaning: A young person who is poor but wise is much better off than an old king who has become foolish and refuses to listen to advice. True value comes from wisdom and humility, not from a royal crown or advanced age. Leaders bring disaster on themselves when pride makes them unteachable.

Wisdom can lift a person from a prison cell all the way to the royal throne, just as God once elevated Joseph in Egypt. At the same time, an unwise king who inherited his throne can lose his wealth and end up in poverty. Earthly rank does not guarantee lasting security without good judgment.

The Preacher watched crowds of people quickly leave the old ruler to follow the new, rising young leader. People naturally flock to the fresh new face who steps into power. Yet this popular excitement shows how fickle human loyalty really is.

Huge crowds cheered the new ruler at the beginning, but future generations will eventually grow tired of him and forget him. Earthly fame and political popularity never last. Only the kingdom of God offers glory that will never fade away.
